verdict.rationale: Aider's documented automation is limited to one-off runs: `--message` performs a single instruction and exits, `coder.run` executes one instruction, and `--watch-files` reacts to file comments. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in way to define recurring schedules. Running these one-off commands from an external scheduler like cron would be a user-side workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
